items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Well me, John Tassel. That was John Tassel's band.

ctx.x: Who was in Wooden Joe's band?

Well me, John Tassel. That was John Tassel's band. But Joe had a band before we got with Joe. Had a fella named Stu. We just smoked food and just smoked him. We smoked, got to hand one at it. He went inside of his mouth and he's crying in the other side. He said, you know my name, do you? Stu. Yeah. Kind of say, yeah. I went with him once there but I didn't stay with him long.
That was a camellia band. Tell him a camellia band.
